lines.2: 「Are you stupid?! It's me! Me, me!」
lines.5: 「The child who was crying in the park yesterday?」
lines.6: 「I'm not a child! You're doing this on purpose, aren't you?!」
lines.7: 「And a poser surname like Yashi is wasted on you.」
lines.8: 「All right, then. From now on, I'm calling you Coconut.」
lines.9: Crab gave Nagomi a pat on the shoulder.
lines.10: 「U-um... I don't think you should pick on a first-year like that, Crabby.」
lines.11: 「Don't worry. I'll be the one doing the bullying.」
lines.12: Nagomi seized Crab's cheek and pulled it sharply to one side.
lines.13: 「Whah, wha're you doin'? Leggo! (Whoa, what are you doing? Let go!)」
lines.16: 「Heh heh... Let's see how long you last.」
lines.18: 「No, they hate each other. How does that look friendly to you?」
lines.19: 「Hey, that's enough. It would be a shame to leave marks on such a cute face.」
lines.23: 「...She certainly is a spirited first-year. Excellent.」
